{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-oh-d","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"8c6f1baa0c3257fbf4fe5bab0d8e4d9dc245363ff9cc2276ab35e5e12b340d42","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-oh-class-d:lineage:46","source_registry_sha256":"33124b165dc74fabcff4bbcd8fd15db36bbe4a69a10e7def76a9d71752a5128b","source_liveness_sha256":null},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C","chunk_id":"C.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Sharing the road: second part","heading":"Sharing the road: second part — C","learner_facing":true,"markdown":"FACT_ID: sec11-F01 | anchor: A70
Do not cut in front of a large vehicle to reach a turn or exit or to enter a single-lane work zone ahead of it. [A70]
Source: [A70 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec11-F02 | anchor: A70
A truck's or bus's no-zones are blind areas beside it, behind it and in front of it, with larger trucks having larger blind areas. [A70]
Source: [A70 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec11-F03 | anchor: A70
The handbook warns that if you cannot see a truck or bus driver's face in the outside mirror, that driver cannot see you. [A70]
Source: [A70 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec11-F04 | anchor: A70
Avoid remaining alongside a large vehicle longer than necessary because a swerve or lane change creates a greater crash risk. [A70]
Source: [A70 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec11-F05 | anchor: A71
In ideal conditions, a loaded truck with good tires and adjusted brakes traveling fifty-five miles per hour needs at least three hundred thirty-five feet to stop. [A71]
Source: [A71 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec11-F06 | anchor: A71
The handbook's loaded-truck example is more than one and a half times the stopping distance of a passenger vehicle. [A71]
Source: [A71 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec11-F07 | anchor: A71
Before moving back in front of a passed large vehicle, see its entire front in the rear-view mirror and maintain speed. [A71]
Source: [A71 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec11-F08 | anchor: A71
A large vehicle's rear blind area can extend as far as two hundred feet behind it. [A71]
Source: [A71 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec11-F09 | anchor: A71
Do not follow a large vehicle closely; position your vehicle where its driver can see you in an outside mirror and where your own forward view is not blocked. [A71]
Source: [A71 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec11-F10 | anchor: A71
Avoid the right lane behind a large vehicle on steep climbs or descents and near truck weigh stations where trucks may rejoin faster traffic. [A71]
Source: [A71 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec11-F11 | anchor: A71
For an approaching emergency vehicle using flashing lights and an audible warning, safely move right and stop without blocking an intersection. [A71]
Source: [A71 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec11-F12 | anchor: A71
Remain stopped for an approaching emergency vehicle until it passes or a law-enforcement officer directs otherwise. [A71]
Source: [A71 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec11-F13 | anchor: A71
Ohio's move-over rule covers stopped police, emergency, road-service, waste-collection, highway-maintenance and public-utility-commission vehicles displaying warning lights. [A71]
Source: [A71 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec11-F14 | anchor: A71
Approach an authorized roadside stopped vehicle cautiously, slow down and move into a lane away from it when traffic and safety permit. [A71]
Source: [A71 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0071]
